targets.productDescription: Ban Gu's Book of Han is the first official dynastic history in the Chinese historiographic tradition. Commissioned and completed under the Eastern Han, it chronicles the Western Han dynasty from the founding emperor Gaozu (Liu Bang) in 206 BCE through the fall of the usurper Wang Mang in 23 CE. This complete English edition presents all 100 juan (118 files in the split-volume presentation) in reflowable e-book format. The translation was generated with AI tools under the direction and editorial supervision of Garrett M. Petersen.
